originalTitle: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
summary: Iranian news agencies said retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.
content:
Vessels were visible across the Strait of Hormuz from Oman this week

American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday, US Central Command (Centcom) has said.

Centcom said the US strikes followed "recent attempted attacks" by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

The Iranian Red Crescent said four people including a young child were killed in the US attacks, and more than 50 injured, when after a US missile attack shrapnel hit a home where a wedding celebration was taking place in Sirik in southern Iran.

In response, Iran launched attacks at US military bases in Iraq and Jordan, according to local state media and the Jordanian Armed Forces. Attacks were also reported in Kuwait and Bahrain.

The IRGC said the US would "regret" the strikes. By early Wednesday, it had launched a barrage of ballistic missiles at a US Marine base in Jordan's Aqaba in retaliation for the Sirik attack, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency.

The Jordanian Armed Forces said it had intercepted 13 ballistic missiles, 10 of which were destroyed, while three fell in remote areas. There were no deaths or injuries as a result of the attack from Iran.

The network also said that the country's national security centre had warned residents of the Aqaba and Mafraq governates of falling debris, adding that the warning had since ended.

Separately, the Kuwait army said its air defences were responding to Iranian missile attacks early Wednesday.

Several explosions were also reported in Bahrain following attacks by Iran, according to Iranian state media.

Donald Trump, when the US strikes were announced on Tuesday afternoon, warned that Iran would be hit again at "a much harder and higher level" if it retaliated.

The attack follows the first known US strikes on Iran since late July earlier this week, when forces attacked two rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait. Tehran retaliated by firing missiles at air bases in Jordan and a drone at the UAE.

Centcom said US forces had begun striking IRGC targets at 12:00 ET (16:00 GMT), and had completed the strikes by early Wednesday.

Iranian state media reported a four-year-old child was among the four who had died in the Sirik attack, while other reports said projectiles had hit the areas of Chabahar and Konarak and an airport in Jiroft, and that explosions were heard in Qeshm island and Bandar Abbas.

US Navy Captain Tim Hawkins, speaking on behalf of Centcom, told the BBC it was aware of reports from Iranian state media of the attack in Sirik.

He added: "The US military never targets civilians, unlike the IRGC."

The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February, with Iran responding by attacking Israel, US bases and allied states in the Gulf, and effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz to marine traffic.

A US-Iran agreement, known as the Memorandum of Understanding, to extend a ceasefire between the two countries was signed in June.

However that agreement has expired, leading to a resumption of hostilities. Both the US and Iran have also fired on shipping, with Tehran targeting vessels it says have sought to cross the Strait without its permission and the US enforcing a naval blockade of Iranian ports.

Washington also announced a fresh sanctions campaign on 24 August aimed at further isolating Tehran and expanding secondary sanctions against its allies.

Speaking at a G20 finance ministers meeting, the US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that many US allies "came forward and said they will do whatever is necessary" concerning the sanctions against Iran.

Iranian officials and state media have largely dismissed the campaign as a continuation of previous US economic measures, which they argue followed Washington's military failure in the recent conflict.

However on Tuesday Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian was quoted by state media as saying if the US returned to committing to the agreement, Iran would reciprocate.
chineseTitle: 官方媒体报道，伊朗在美国袭击婚礼派对造成四人死亡后进行报复
chineseSummary: 伊朗新闻机构称，对美国目标的报复性导弹和无人机袭击已经开始。
chineseContent:
本周从阿曼穿过霍尔木兹海峡可以看到船只

美国中央司令部（Centcom）表示，美军周二恢复对伊朗的打击。

中央司令部表示，美国发动袭击是在伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）“最近试图袭击”霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运之后进行的。

伊朗红新月会表示，美国导弹袭击的弹片击中伊朗南部锡里克一户正在举行婚礼的房屋，造成包括一名幼儿在内的四人在美国袭击中丧生，五十多人受伤。

据当地官方媒体和约旦武装部队报道，作为回应，伊朗对驻伊拉克和约旦的美国军事基地发动了袭击。据报道，科威特和巴林也发生了袭击事件。

伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，美国将对此次袭击“感到遗憾”。据伊朗半官方通讯社塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，周三早些时候，伊朗已向约旦亚喀巴的美国海军陆战队基地发射了一系列弹道导弹，以报复锡里克袭击事件。

约旦武装部队表示，已拦截13枚弹道导弹，其中10枚被摧毁，另外3枚落在偏远地区。来自伊朗的袭击没有造成人员伤亡。

该网络还表示，该国国家安全中心已警告亚喀巴和马弗拉克省的居民注意掉落的碎片，并补充说警告现已结束。

另外，科威特军队表示，其防空系统正在对周三早些时候伊朗的导弹袭击做出反应。

据伊朗官方媒体报道，在伊朗袭击后，巴林也发生了几起爆炸。

周二下午美国宣布发动袭击时，唐纳德·特朗普警告称，如果伊朗进行报复，将再次受到“更严厉、更高水平”的打击。

此次袭击是美国自本周早些时候七月下旬以来对伊朗进行的首次已知袭击，当时部队袭击了海峡拉拉克岛的两座火箭发射器。德黑兰向约旦空军基地发射导弹，并向阿联酋发射无人机进行报复。

中央司令部表示，美军已于美国东部时间 12:00（格林尼治标准时间 16:00）开始袭击 IRGC 目标，并于周三早些时候完成袭击。

伊朗官方媒体报道说，在锡里克袭击中死亡的四人中有一名四岁儿童，而其他报道称，弹丸击中了恰巴哈尔和科纳拉克地区以及吉罗夫特的一个机场，格什姆岛和阿巴斯港也听到了爆炸声。

美国海军上校蒂姆·霍金斯代表中央司令部发言，他告诉英国广播公司，他们已获悉伊朗官方媒体有关锡里克袭击事件的报道。

他补充道：“与伊斯兰革命卫队不同，美国军队从不以平民为目标。”

2月28日，美国和以色列对伊朗发动了大范围的打击，伊朗的回应是攻击以色列、美国基地和海湾盟国，并有效关闭了霍尔木兹海峡的海上交通。

六月，美国与伊朗签署了一项延长两国停火的协议，即谅解备忘录。

然而该协议已经到期，导致敌对行动重新开始。美国和伊朗也向航运开火，德黑兰称其目标是未经其许可试图穿越海峡的船只，而美国则对伊朗港口实施海上封锁。

华盛顿还于 8 月 24 日宣布了新的制裁行动，旨在进一步孤立德黑兰并扩大对其盟友的二级制裁。

美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在二十国集团财长会议上发表讲话时表示，许多美国盟友站出来表示，他们将就制裁伊朗问题采取一切必要措施。

伊朗官员和官方媒体在很大程度上驳斥了这一行动，认为这是美国之前经济措施的延续，他们认为这些措施是在华盛顿在最近的冲突中军事失败之后采取的。

然而周二，官方媒体援引伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安的话说，如果美国重新承诺遵守该协议，伊朗将予以回报。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
